reasons: Semester 8 is the only remaining semester, but CS4218, CS3227, CS3234 and CS4248 are all required there.
CS4218 must be taken with CS3227, and CS3227 is fixed in semester 8, so CS4218 is also fixed there.
That gives 4 modules in semester 8, exceeding the stated maximum of 3 modules per semester.
